project_comments.note: Gold Nugget (from WP-002): The `string | { store: LedgerStore }` overload pattern in propagateDependencyUnblock/propagateDependencyReblock is a reusable architectural idiom worth formalising. It allows top-level callers to provide a project path (which triggers LedgerStore construction + lock acquisition) while internal callers share an already-opened store (avoiding redundant construction and double-locking). Consider documenting this pattern in mcp-server/docs/agents/project-manifest/tech-stack.md under 'Internal Function Conventions' so future tool function authors working with LedgerStore can adopt it consistently.
